mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening private demand, which signals a contractionary economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 in walk-forward validation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months indicates a weakening in real economic output, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 530.0 thousand units after a prior decline signals renewed housing market confidence, which boosts consumer wealth and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 530.0 and rising from a prior low
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds 530.0 after a decline, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.02 in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 220.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts, which increases real rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0 with 12-month growth > 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 in walk-forward validation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 13,000 billion chained dollars, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 < 13000 and INDPRO < 94.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
